lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is the Telluride P&Z hearing on the Shandoka Lot Redevelopment — a Preliminary PUD application for town-owned property at 860 Black Bear Rd that would increase dimensional limitations, finally getting its hearing after being continued from September. Town Council follows on Monday with first readings of ordinances touching the Telluride Energy Mitigation Program and the gondola IGA's cost-sharing extension, while the Hospital District takes up a possible Two Site Model that could reshape how and where care gets delivered across the valley.
